questions.q: Wakanda's wealth rests on deposits of which metal?
questions.why: Wakanda is a hidden African nation sustained by vast vibranium deposits, which Ulysses Klaw repeatedly tried to steal.

questions.q: Which actor played T'Challa in the 2018 film Black Panther?
questions.why: Chadwick Boseman played T'Challa in the MCU, starting before the 2018 solo film.

questions.q: How is Shuri related to T'Challa in the comics?
questions.why: Shuri is T'Challa's sister; she took on the Black Panther role while he was in a coma.

questions.q: Which duo created the Black Panther?
questions.why: Stan Lee scripted and Jack Kirby plotted and drew the character's debut.

questions.q: In which year did the Black Panther first appear, in Fantastic Four #52?
questions.why: T'Challa debuted in Fantastic Four #52, cover-dated July 1966.

questions.q: In the comics, T'Challa gains his Panther boosts by ritually drinking the essence of what?
options: The blood of a sacred big cat
questions.why: The Wakandan Black Panther ritual involves ingesting the essence of a heart-shaped herb, boosting strength, speed and senses.

questions.q: In 2006, during Reginald Hudlin's run, whom did T'Challa marry?
questions.why: T'Challa married X-Men member Storm in 2006; the marriage was later annulled.

questions.q: What was the name of T'Challa's mother, who died giving birth to him?
questions.why: Queen N'Yami died in childbirth; T'Chaka's second wife Ramonda later gave birth to Shuri.

questions.q: In which year did T'Challa join the Avengers in the comics?
questions.why: He joined in 1968, first appearing in The Avengers #52 that May.

questions.q: In the comics, which villain killed T'Challa's father, King T'Chaka?
questions.why: Ulysses Klaw killed T'Chaka and kept raiding Wakanda for its prized metal.
